name: Dropdown menu
summary: A list of actions in a popover with role="menu", with groups, icons, shortcuts, checkable items and a danger item.
description:
Use a dropdown menu for a set of actions on one thing, such as a row or a project, opened from a button. For navigation between pages use links, not a menu.

It opens and closes natively with popovertarget. Add data-v-menu to the menu for focus on open, arrow keys, typeahead and checkable items.

classes.name: v-menu
classes.description: The menu panel, on a popover element with role="menu". Opens below its trigger like .v-popover.

classes.name: v-menu-end
classes.description: Aligns the menu to the end edge of its trigger, for buttons at the end of a toolbar.

classes.name: v-menu-item
classes.description: One item: a button or link with role="menuitem", "menuitemcheckbox" or "menuitemradio". Icons and a <kbd> shortcut sit inside.

classes.name: v-menu-item-danger
classes.description: A destructive item, in the danger colour.

classes.name: v-menu-label
classes.description: A small uppercase group label, with role="presentation".

states.description: On .v-menu: hidden until opened; Escape and a click outside close it.
On the trigger: the id of the menu. Add aria-haspopup="menu".
On an item: closes the menu when the item is chosen, without JS.
On menuitemcheckbox and menuitemradio items: "true" shows a tick or a dot. The JS toggles it on click, one radio per group.
Dimmed and not clickable, but still announced. Skipped by the arrow keys. disabled works too.

hooks.name: data-v-menu
hooks.description: Moves focus into the menu on open, adds arrow keys, Home, End, typeahead and Tab to close, toggles checkable items and returns focus to the trigger.

events.name: v:select
events.description: Fires when an enabled item is chosen. Call preventDefault() to keep the menu open after a menuitem.

keyboard.action: On the trigger, opens the menu with focus on the first item. On an item, chooses it: a menuitem closes the menu, checkbox and radio items stay open.
On the trigger, opens the menu on the first or last item. In the menu, moves to the next or previous item and wraps.
Moves to the first or last item.
Typeahead: moves to the next item whose text starts with that letter.
Closes the menu and moves on from the trigger.
Closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger.

a11y: Items get tabindex="-1" and are reached with the arrow keys, so the open menu is one Tab stop.
Wrap each labelled group in role="group" with aria-labelledby on its .v-menu-label, and give the menu an aria-label.
Checked state is in aria-checked, not only in the drawn tick, so screen readers hear it.
Shortcut hints in <kbd> are only hints: the page has to handle those keys itself.

examples.title: Actions menu
examples.description: Groups, shortcuts, a disabled item, checkable items and a danger item. Open it and use the arrow keys or type a letter.
